title: Midnight Canadian Pork Chops
description: A simple, flavorful dish featuring pork chops baked with a blend of spices and herbs, perfect for a late-night snack.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
In a shallow dish, mix together breadcrumbs and brown sugar.
Dip each pork chop into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Sear the coated pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with parsley.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
